loud_115: a loud source (a guitar cab or kick at 115 dB SPL), the V76 turned down 15 dB to 9 dB: realistic, the capsule and tube driven hard
brownout: mains at the V76's lowest rating, 198 V (10 % low), the NG's 300 V scaled with it to 270 V
weak_ng: a weak NG rectifier: 220 V open circuit instead of 300 (the U47's 105 V rail drops with it)
tired_vf14: an aged VF14: half its emission (kg1 doubled)
small_bv8: a BV8 on a quarter of the core area with twice the turns: the same inductance, twice the flux density
hum_heavy: dried-out filter capacitors: the NG's ripple 40 dB and T90's field 20 dB over spike-2's calibration (out of spec)
microphonic: a VF14 Neumann would have rejected: its modes' peaks at -20 dB re the capsule's signal (30 dB over chain_spike's invented 'selected' tube)
